back: The small agent harness you build one step at a time. Each step adds a few lines and runs a checkpoint.
A model that answers from a fixed list. The same script gives the same reply and token counts every run.
It is repeatable, free and offline. A change in your code shows up in the output, not in the model.
front: Why does the build start with a scripted model?

back: A JSON file that lists the scripted replies one run uses. The --fake flag points Rein at it.
A folder with its own Python packages, kept apart from the system's.
No. It uses the standard library only. Only the real-model path imports the SDK.
front: Does the scripted run need a package?

back: In the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable. Never in a file under git, never in the browser.
